why_ai: A licensed clinician must prescribe and carry malpractice risk, though low-acuity visits face AI triage.
why_clarity: Platforms measure visit volume, not whether patients got better.
why_digital: Questionnaires and video in, prescriptions and advice out, bounded by state licensure.

why_ai: Referral status tracking and structured exchange are automatable coordination work.
why_clarity: Whether a referral, authorization or fill happened is a checkable fact.
why_digital: Phone, fax and portal work across disconnected clinical systems.

why_ai: Outcome analytics on platform and claims data is screen work AI accelerates.
why_clarity: What counts as getting better is contested and confirmed weeks or months later.
why_digital: Platform and claims data in, outcome measures out.

why_ai: Linking encounters across systems is integration work, not invention.
why_clarity: A record either reaches the next clinician or it does not.
why_digital: Clinical records exchanged entirely through software.

why_ai: Ambient documentation is the clearest generative AI application in healthcare.
why_clarity: Notes and codes follow defined formats and are checked against billing rules.
why_digital: Visit audio and text in, notes and codes out.

why_ai: Matching licensed clinicians to state demand is a forecasting and assignment problem.
why_clarity: Licence rules are exact and coverage gaps show up every hour.
why_digital: Licence and demand data in, staffing assignments out.

why_ai: Retrieving and surfacing patient history is a solved retrieval problem elsewhere.
why_clarity: Surfaced history is checkable, but its effect on decisions shows later.
why_digital: Pharmacy and exchange records in, in-visit summaries out.

why_ai: Medical directors answer to regulators for prescribing outliers the statistics reveal.
why_clarity: Prescribing rates compare directly to guideline-concordant benchmarks.
why_digital: Platform prescribing data in, reports to regulators and boards out.

why_ai: The licensed clinician owns each prescribe, refer or reassure decision without an exam.
why_clarity: Decisions recur, but whether they worked is almost never measured.
why_digital: Questionnaires and video in, e-prescriptions and referrals out.

why_ai: Most of the coordinator's day is retrieval, status chasing and transcription.
why_clarity: Tasks recur and each referral's status is a checkable fact.
why_digital: Phones, fax and browser tabs across disconnected systems.

why_ai: Contract clinicians carry the licence and malpractice exposure for every decision.
why_clarity: High-volume visits get no feedback on whether patients improved.
why_digital: Remote visits from a queue, licensed state by state.
